name: Dr.V-Bench
description: Dr.V-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating model performance on clinically oriented tasks (case understanding, diagnosis, or treatment recommendation) presented as vignettes and questions. It contains items designed to measure domain-specific medical knowledge and reasoning under clinical contexts. The dataset is intended for automated evaluation of answer correctness and clinical reasoning.
reputation: Emerging/limited adoption outside its originating group; used for targeted medical-model evaluations.
